svg.title: Qwen trait profiles in descending PC1 order

g.text: 15 of 275 personas; highest first. Height = within-trait percentile (0-100).
15 of 240 mapped traits; descriptive groups, not a valence scale or measured continuum.
Same-space activation cosines, not independent psychological ratings. Curves are not probability densities.
